diagnosis: Customer reports seat count discrepancy between invoice and console. Entitlement service is currently unavailable, so real-time seat data cannot be verified. The ticket requires human investigation to reconcile counts once the service is restored.
reply:
Thank you for reaching out regarding the seat count on your invoice. I understand you're seeing a discrepancy between your invoice and what appears in your console, and I'd like to help get this resolved.

At this time, our entitlement verification systems are experiencing a temporary issue that prevents me from confirming your current seat count in real time. Because this involves a billing discrepancy that requires accurate entitlement data to investigate properly, I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.

Once our systems are fully restored, the specialist will be able to compare your invoice details against your account records and provide you with a clear reconciliation of your seat count and any applicable proration.
